59:     -------
60:     dist : float
61:         Squared distance between x and y.
62:     """
63:     be = instantiate_backend(be, x, y)
64:     x = be.array(x)
65:     y = be.array(y)
66:     dist = 0.0
67:     for di in range(be.shape(x)[0]):
68:         diff = x[di] - y[di]
69:         dist += diff * diff
70:     return dist
71: 
72: 
73: @njit()
74: def njit_accumulated_matrix(s1, s2, mask):
75:     """Compute the accumulated cost matrix score between two time series.
76: 
77:     Parameters
78:     ----------
79:     s1 : array-like, shape=(sz1, d)
80:         First time series.
81:     s2 : array-like, shape=(sz2, d)
82:         Second time series.
83:     mask : array-like, shape=(sz1, sz2)
84:         Mask. Unconsidered cells must have False values.
85: 
86:     Returns
87:     -------
88:     mat : array-like, shape=(sz1, sz2)
89:         Accumulated cost matrix.
90:     """
91:     l1 = s1.shape[0]
92:     l2 = s2.shape[0]
93:     cum_sum = numpy.full((l1 + 1, l2 + 1), numpy.inf)
94:     cum_sum[0, 0] = 0.0
95: 
96:     for i in range(l1):
97:         for j in range(l2):
98:             if mask[i, j]:
99:                 cum_sum[i + 1, j + 1] = _njit_local_squared_dist(s1[i], s2[j])
100:                 cum_sum[i + 1, j + 1] += min(
101:                     cum_sum[i, j + 1], cum_sum[i + 1, j], cum_sum[i, j]
102:                 )
103:     return cum_sum[1:, 1:]
104: 
105: 
106: def accumulated_matrix(s1, s2, mask, be=None):
107:     """Compute the accumulated cost matrix score between two time series.
108: 
109:     Parameters
110:     ----------
111:     s1 : array-like, shape=(sz1, d)
112:         First time series.
113:     s2 : array-like, shape=(sz2, d)
114:         Second time series.
115:     mask : array-like, shape=(sz1, sz2)
116:         Mask. Unconsidered cells must have False values.
117:     be : Backend object or string or None
118:         Backend. If `be` is an instance of the class `NumPyBackend` or the string `"numpy"`,
119:         the NumPy backend is used.
120:         If `be` is an instance of the class `PyTorchBackend` or the string `"pytorch"`,
121:         the PyTorch backend is used.
122:         If `be` is `None`, the backend is determined by the input arrays.
123:         See our :ref:`dedicated user-guide page <backend>` for more information.
124: 
125:     Returns
126:     -------
127:     mat : array-like, shape=(sz1, sz2)
128:         Accumulated cost matrix.
129:     """
130:     warnings.warn(
131:         "This method is deprecated, use tslearn.metrics.accumulated_matrix instead.",
132:         DeprecationWarning
133:     )
134: 
135:     be = instantiate_backend(be, s1, s2)
136:     s1 = be.array(s1)
137:     s2 = be.array(s2)
138:     l1 = be.shape(s1)[0]
139:     l2 = be.shape(s2)[0]
140:     cum_sum = be.full((l1 + 1, l2 + 1), be.inf)
141:     cum_sum[0, 0] = 0.0
142: 
143:     for i in range(l1):
144:         for j in range(l2):
145:             if mask[i, j]:
146:                 cum_sum[i + 1, j + 1] = _local_squared_dist(s1[i], s2[j], be=be)
147:                 cum_sum[i + 1, j + 1] += min(
148:                     cum_sum[i, j + 1], cum_sum[i + 1, j], cum_sum[i, j]
149:                 )
150:     return cum_sum[1:, 1:]
151: 
152: 
153: @njit(nogil=True)
154: def _njit_dtw(s1, s2, mask):
155:     """Compute the dynamic time warping score between two time series.
156: 
157:     Parameters
158:     ----------
159:     s1 : array-like, shape=(sz1, d)
160:         First time series.
161:     s2 : array-like, shape=(sz2, d)
162:         Second time series.
163:     mask : array-like, shape=(sz1, sz2)
164:         Mask. Unconsidered cells must have False values.
165: 
166:     Returns
167:     -------
168:     dtw_score : float
169:         Dynamic Time Warping score between both time series.
170: 
171:     """
172:     cum_sum = njit_accumulated_matrix(s1, s2, mask)
173:     return numpy.sqrt(cum_sum[-1, -1])
174: 
175: 
176: def _dtw(s1, s2, mask, be=None):
177:     """Compute the dynamic time warping score between two time series.
178: 
179:     Parameters
180:     ----------
181:     s1 : array-like, shape=(sz1, d)
182:         First time series.
183:     s2 : array-like, shape=(sz2, d)
184:         Second time series.
185:     mask : array-like, shape=(sz1, sz2)
186:         Mask. Unconsidered cells must have False values.
187:     be : Backend object or string or None
188:         Backend. If `be` is an instance of the class `NumPyBackend` or the string `"numpy"`,
189:         the NumPy backend is used.
190:         If `be` is an instance of the class `PyTorchBackend` or the string `"pytorch"`,
191:         the PyTorch backend is used.
192:         If `be` is `None`, the backend is determined by the input arrays.
193:         See our :ref:`dedicated user-guide page <backend>` for more information.
194: 
195:     Returns
196:     -------
197:     dtw_score : float
198:         Dynamic Time Warping score between both time series.
199: 
200:     """
201:     be = instantiate_backend(be, s1, s2)
202:     s1 = be.array(s1)
203:     s2 = be.array(s2)
204:     cum_sum = accumulated_matrix(s1, s2, mask, be=be)
205:     return be.sqrt(cum_sum[-1, -1])
206:

208: @njit()
209: def _njit_return_path(acc_cost_mat):
210:     """Return path from accumulated cost matrix.
211: 
212:     Parameters
213:     ----------
214:     acc_cost_mat : array-like, shape=(sz1, sz2)
